title: The Fed paused, but a December hike looks likely. What the 'hawkish hold' means for India
short: The Fed paused. Why India is still watching December
dek: The US Federal Reserve kept rates at 3.75%–4% on 28 October, but two members wanted a hike and markets expect one in December. Here's why that matters for Indian yields, the rupee and the RBI.
card: The Fed held at 3.75%–4%, but two members wanted a hike now. India's yield cushion over the US has shrunk to about 2.4 points.
